universe.source: seed: single-coin sample, not the universe

notes: Crypto trades 24/7: buckets align to 00:00 UTC, not an equity session open. There is no session filter; a bar is never dropped for falling outside market hours.

Every bar carries its source time (t), observed time (observed_at) and state chip (origin: recorded for a fetched base bar, reconstructed for a locally derived bar). Synthetic bars are never written by this collector.
Derived intervals are aggregated by the collector, never fetched: 3m/5m/9m/15m/30m from 1m, 2h/4h from 1h, 1w from 1d.
CoinGecko-labelled coins have no intraday base: CoinGecko free OHLC has no 1m/1h series, so their intraday intervals are absent by design and labelled as such.
